legal.description: RBI Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory operationalized 01.07.2025; KreditBee listed as DLA deployed by Northern Arc Capital Limited (NBFC) per RBI directory. Also listed as deployed by KrazyBee Services Limited itself.

RBI issued digital lending guidelines requiring SRO constitution, all loan servicing through regulated entities, and customer protection measures. KreditBee operates within this framework via RBI-registered NBFC partners.
RBI-registered NBFC-ND-SI (Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company - Systemically Important) licence since May 2017. Currently rated CARE A/Stable.
CRISIL upgraded ratings to A+/Stable/A1+; total bank loan facilities rated Rs 1850 crore; ~89% of portfolio from unsecured digital personal loans.
